verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Chargebee generates invoices: quotes convert into regular invoices, and VAT can be configured and added to the invoice amount. Nothing in the pack covers the specific elements this story asks for. Missing for 10: credit notes, receipts, sequential invoice numbering, custom fields, memos, automatic delivery to customers, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, the platform generates compliant invoices, credit notes, and receipts — sequential numbering, custom fields, memos — delivered to customers automatically

citations.quote: A quote can be converted to a regular invoice once the customer accepts it.
Chargebee allows you to configure VAT rates and whether to include VAT in the prices or add it to the invoice amount.
